2459-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2393-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

856-5776-6495-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
856-5776-6495-7396.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-4068-4247-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2292-2415-4063.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

4247-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

575-997-1794.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-997-1794.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

215-4460-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-4460-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

647-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-4772-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4772-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

271-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

140-3245-5313.description:
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
140-3245-5313.notes: You can also use the {R} made by Treasonous Ogre to cast Exsanguinate for more mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

872-1671-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
872-1671-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2539-3094-4659-5295-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-5295-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4907-5330-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-4907-5330-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

628-2921-7200.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

2438-4446-4681-5170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2438-4446-4681-5170.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

969-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2341-2347-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Firemind Vessel and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding two mana of differing colors.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Firemind Vessel and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Firemind Vessel and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3809-5184-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

57-2341-4068-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
You control at least one Mountain.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-2341-4068-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4359-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4359-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4943-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4943-6556-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-4518.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-4518.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Kor Skyfisher and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-4518.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

413-2178-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
413-2178-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-6774.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-6774.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

474-803-4394-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {R}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

3291-3657--85.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least six.
3291-3657--85.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat.

575-1497-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1497-5971.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
When Wild Cantor dies, Yedora triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Wild Cantor enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers, turning Wild Cantor face-up.
Repeat.

539-1849-2244-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-1849-2244-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

969-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
969-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

539-2034-5003-5671.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant or a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

1857-2178-4410.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1857-2178-4410.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

232-4050-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
232-4050-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

542-1031-2103.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Capture of Jingzhou and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2360-2751-5089.notablePrerequisites:
You control artifact creatures that can tap to add at least {3}.
Strionic Resonator does not have summoning sickness.
2360-2751-5089.description:
Activate Karn by putting a loyalty counter on them, causing Strionic Resonator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Lita triggers.
In response, activate artifact creatures by tapping them to add at least {3}.
Continuing to hold priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Lita's triggered ability.
Resolve the copied ability, untapping all artifact creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3950-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Kukemssa Serpent.
A player controls no Islands.
3950-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Kukemssa Serpent to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Kukemssa Serpent's controller controls no Islands, Kukemssa Serpent triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Kukemssa Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Kukemssa Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

262-3957-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-3957-5070.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Angelic Chorus three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

2556-3632-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
